instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a brightly lit office interior with a wooden door, a red desk, and a window with blinds. On the left, the woman in the black blazer (R3) stands facing right. In the center, the man in the dark suit (R2) stands facing forward. On the right, the woman in the black shirt and red skirt (R1) leans forward facing left. All three smile and look down as they stack their hands together in a central huddle gesture of teamwork over the red desk. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting, creating a natural and collaborative atmosphere with realistic colors.
elements: R1 leans forward into the shared hand-stack huddle rather than R2 doing so
R2 holds the forward-facing central standing role in the hand-stack huddle rather than R1
R3 faces toward the huddle from the opposite side while joining the hand stack with R1 and R2
R1, R2, and R3 all stack their hands together in a central teamwork gesture
the hand-stack huddle takes place over a red desk
the setting is a brightly lit office interior
